fields.raw_value: G CORP Buildwell Pvt Ltd is a subsidiary company under GCORP group. As GCORP group, company has executed few Projects in Bangalore and other cities. In the last 5 years, the Project ICON-North, a group housing residential apartment project situated at Thanisandra Main road, Bangalore North has been developed in phases. The Project is developed on the land spread over 19 acres and consisting of 12 towers with 1131 apartments. Out of which, 2 towers ( 158 apartments) Towers A and B has been completed , Occupancy certifiate recieved , handed over and occupied. Hence , for this submission, considered as completion.
